svg.text: Phase 3: Autonomous Pipeline — 9 Stages · 3 Gates · 2 Modes
Gate 0: Understand the Problem · Gate 1: Do the Right Thing (Plan) · Gate 2: Do the Thing Right (Build) · DDD Compounds Every Run
— shared by both modes · "Do we understand it? How? Is this structural?"
Human: define goals · ESCALATE · approve REFLECT
"Achieve X→Y" — loop ④⑥ until DoD met, periodic ⑤
Safeguards: Budget Gate · Stuck Detection · Regression Revert · Max Cycles
Overnight: Job System autonomous execution · DoD met → stop + notify
— shared quality gate · "Is it correct? Is it qualified? What did we learn?"
Fresh-context Sub-Agent — sees only the diff, not the builder's reasoning
9 Specialist Lenses: Correctness · Concurrency · State-Machine · Integration · Performance · Security · Operational · API-Contract · Red-Team
37 Review Patterns (RP1-RP37) + Blocking Constraints from TECH.md ★ · Max 3 iterations
Findings: fix → re-verify → converge · Max 3 iterations · ESCALATE if stuck · SSA already done in Gate 1 (pre-coding)
Coding as Black Box — 3 phases, 9 stages, 3 gates, 2 sub-agents. Knowledge compounds.
In EVALUATE→THINK: is the framing right? · diagnose-before-build + M3 skeptic
After PLAN: direction · constraints · failure patterns · structural-vs-patch (SSA)
In DELIVER: attack output · find bugs builder can't see · 6-layer converge
3 phases (Decision · Execution · Delivery) · 9 stages · 2 sub-agents (Skeptic+SSA | Attacker) · 3 gates · 6-layer convergence
